name: Understand Anything
description: Understand Anything is a Claude Code plugin that analyzes your project with a multi-agent pipeline, builds a knowledge graph of every file, function, class, and dependency, then gives you an interactive dashboard to explore it all visually. Stop reading code blind. Start seeing the big picture.
longDescription:
Installs with `claude plugin install understand-anything@claude-community` from `Lum1104/Understand-Anything`.

You just joined a new team. The codebase is 200,000 lines of code. Where do you even start?

Understand Anything is a Claude Code plugin that analyzes your project with a multi-agent pipeline, builds a knowledge graph of every file, function, class, and dependency, then gives you an interactive dashboard to explore it all visually. Stop reading code blind. Start seeing the big picture.
